name: Acetylpropionylmorphine
summary: Acetylpropionylmorphine is an opioid analog that is an ester of morphine. It was developed in the early 1900s after first being synthesized in United Kingdom in 1875 but shelved along with heroin and various other esters of morphine.

pharmacology.text: It is described as being virtually identical to heroin and morphine in its effects, and consequently was itself banned internationally in 1930 by the Health Committee of the League of Nations, in order to prevent its sale as an unscheduled alternative to heroin.

uses.text: Acetylpropionylmorphone was never used medically, instead being widely sold as one of the first "designer drugs" for around five years following the introduction of the first international restrictions on the sale of heroin in 1925.

sideEffects.en: Its effects are described as virtually identical to those of heroin. Opioids cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils, they can slow or stop breathing, and regular use leads to strong dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它的作用據描述幾乎與海洛因相同。鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小，可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，長期使用會造成強烈的成癮與戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它的作用据描述几乎与海洛因相同。鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小，可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，长期使用会造成强烈的成瘾与戒断反应。

fact.en: It was first made in Britain in 1875 and shelved, then sold in the late 1920s as one of the first designer drugs, created specifically to sidestep the new international ban on heroin. It was banned in turn in 1930.
fact.zh: 它最早在1875年於英國合成後被擱置，到1920年代後期才作為最早的設計師藥物之一販售，目的就是規避新的國際海洛因禁令。它隨後也在1930年被禁。
fact.zhHans: 它最早在1875年于英国合成后被搁置，到1920年代后期才作为最早的设计师药物之一贩售，目的就是规避新的国际海洛因禁令。它随后也在1930年被禁。
